newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hoechst - sees 97 net profit to below 96.
newsitem.headline: Hoechst - sees 97 net profit to below 96.

text.p: German chemical giant Hoechst AG said on Wednesday it expected to see a slight rise in full-year operating profits on a comparable basis, but that net profit in 1997 would be lower than in 1996 because of one-off income in 1996.
"We are optimistic that operating profit for the full year will increase slightly on a comparable basis," Hoechst said.
"Since the high level of extraordinary gains on the sale of companies and shareholdings in 1996 will not be incurred in 1997, net income will be lower," the group said in its interim statement.
"Sales will decline markedly due to spin-offs, eg, of the specialty chemicals business to Clariant and the polypropylene business to Targor," Hoechst said.
